Container.Name: pia-iptv
Container.Overview:
m3u-editor with a built-in Private Internet Access VPN and kill switch, in one container.
The container connects to PIA first, then starts m3u-editor. Its playlist and guide syncs and the streams it relays use the VPN; if the tunnel drops, that traffic stops instead of falling back to your regular connection.
• WireGuard (default) or OpenVPN, any PIA region • Kill switch: IPv4 locked to the tunnel, IPv6 blocked • Reconnects in place, with server failover • From the LAN, only the web UI / Xtream port is reachable
Open the web UI (default login admin / admin). Players connect with Xtream Codes to http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:36400. In m3u-editor, enable the Proxy toggle on your playlist so streams go through the VPN.
Container.Requires: A Private Internet Access subscription. /dev/net/tun on the server (check with: ls -l /dev/net/tun).

Config.Name: Web UI / Xtream port
Config.Description: m3u-editor's web UI and Xtream server. Players connect here.

Config.Name: PIA region
Config.Description: PIA region: US, Canada and major European cities. us-newjersey = US East. For other regions, edit the container and type any PIA region id.

Config.Name: VPN client
Config.Description: WireGuard is faster and better for 4K.

Config.Name: App URL
Config.Description: How your browser and players reach m3u-editor, without the port: http://YOUR-IP (e.g. http://192.168.0.10). On br0, use the container's own IP. m3u-editor adds the port itself.

Config.Name: LAN network
Config.Description: Optional: only these LAN ranges may reach the web UI / Xtream port, comma-separated, e.g. 192.168.0.0/24. Empty = any source.

Config.Name: Skip web login
Config.Description: true = open the web UI without signing in. Anyone allowed by LAN network gets full admin. Players' Xtream logins are not affected.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: m3u-editor settings, and the generated internal secrets.

Config.Name: DNS servers
Config.Description: Resolvers used through the tunnel. Quad9 | Cloudflare | Google | OpenDNS.

Config.Name: Legacy iptables
Config.Description: Only if the firewall fails to build on your kernel.
